CustomField.description: Text formula written on read from GiftsThisYearAmount (optionally combined with CurrentYearSoftCreditsAmount when a tier's Credit_Type__c = 'Hard + Soft Credits') against the FQS_Donor_Grouping__mdt (Entry / Mid / Major) thresholds. Configure via Setup → Custom Metadata Types or the FQS Setup screen flow.
CustomField.formula: IF((GiftsThisYearAmount + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", CurrentYearSoftCreditsAmount, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Annual_Min_Amount__c, $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Branded_Name__c, IF((GiftsThisYearAmount + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", CurrentYearSoftCreditsAmount, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Annual_Min_Amount__c, $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Branded_Name__c, IF((GiftsThisYearAmount + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Entry.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", CurrentYearSoftCreditsAmount, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Entry.Annual_Min_Amount__c, $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Entry.Branded_Name__c, "")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically. The branded donor grouping name (e.g., Friend, Partner, Champion) for this donor based on current-year giving. Blank means the donor is below the Entry annual threshold. Your administrator controls both the thresholds and the branded names.
CustomField.label: Annual Donor Tier Name
